reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Verified BlobRPCMinValidSlot (L136-148) calculates minStart = currEpoch - minReqEpochs without checking FULU_FORK_EPOCH deprecation deadline. No FULU_FORK_EPOCH references exist in the codebase (grep returned zero matches). The spec (SG-011 INV-001) requires full deprecation after current_epoch >= FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS, but implementation continues serving blobs indefinitely after the deadline.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: Fulu P2P SG-011: blob_sidecars_by_range must respond empty or reject after FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS

reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Verified streamDataColumnBatch breaks out of sidecar loop when quota reaches zero (L164-165), leaving partial sidecars for the last block. Spec SG-008 INV-004 explicitly requires all sidecars of a block must be included if any are included. This violates atomicity during quota exhaustion, causing PeerDAS reconstruction failures.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: Fulu P2P SG-008 INV-004: All sidecars of a block must be included in by_range response if any sidecar is included

reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Verified loader.go UnmarshalConfig (L56-70) performs YAML unmarshaling with no validation that BlobSchedule.MaxBlobsPerBlock <= MAX_BLOB_COMMITMENTS_PER_BLOCK (4096). verifyBlobCommitmentCount (payload.go:238-239) uses MaxBlobsPerBlock(slot) from the loaded config, creating protocol-network mismatch where blocks with >4096 commitments pass validation but cannot be SSZ-encoded for P2P transmission.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: Spec silent on BlobSchedule validation, but SSZ hard limit MAX_BLOB_COMMITMENTS_PER_BLOCK=4096 creates invariant that config must respect

reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Verified broadcastAndReceiveDataColumns (proposer.go:502-504) calls ReceiveDataColumns but never calls setSeenDataColumnIndex, while gossip path (subscriber_data_column_sidecar.go:42) does update cache. Spec SG-010 INV-003 mandates anti-equivocation cache MUST be updated regardless of publishing. Cache inconsistency allows equivocation detection bypass for locally-produced columns.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: Fulu P2P SG-010 INV-003: Anti-equivocation cache MUST be updated regardless of publishing

reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading is correct: streamBlobBatch serves all blobs without epoch filtering. However, this is a duplicate/subset of PROP-6a4369e9-inv-028 which addresses the same root cause (missing FULU_FORK_EPOCH deprecation logic). The transition period filtering is spec-compliant only if FULU_FORK_EPOCH check exists in the handler, which it doesn't. Downgrading as redundant finding.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: Fulu P2P SG-011 INV-002: Transition period serves only pre-Fulu blobs. Same root cause as inv-028.
